card.name: Radiation words in dosimetry sections
card.fires_on: The word radiation (or a similar noun such as exposure) right after absorbed, estimated, or the, in radiation dosimetry text for imaging agents. It also fires on heart in target training heart rate.

modes.label: Radiation after absorbed
modes.description: The word radiation follows estimated absorbed in dosimetry statements for injected imaging agents.

modes.label: Heart rate wording
modes.description: The word heart sits in a noun phrase just before rate in exercise advice.
modes.example: Now you’re ready to determine your target training<< heart>> rate.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the next word of a set noun phrase, such as doses or rate, rather than adding a clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the word radiation in the radiation dose section of imaging drug labels, just before the word doses.
